meta.name: WealthSmith Primitive Radius Tokens
meta.description: Raw border-radius values for the WealthSmith design system. These tokens define the corner-radius scale used across UI components.

xs.description: Tiny rounding for very small UI details

sm.description: Subtle rounding for compact controls and small surfaces

lg.description: Default rounding for buttons, inputs, cards, and common surfaces

xl.description: Large rounding for prominent cards, panels, and dashboard modules

2xl.description: Extra-large rounding for modals, large sheets, and elevated surfaces

full.description: Fully rounded shape for pills, badges, avatars, and circular controls
